data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Aethelthryth, which means 'noble, powerful, ruler'. In Greek mythology, aethel means 'noble' and thryth means 'ruler' or 'power'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ethelyn usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
